findings.location: Adrianna stood with a scowl on her face. Playhouse indeed! She was way too old for that! “I’m going kayaking,” she announced. “You can just have your playhouse.”
findings.source_quote: Adrianna stood with a scowl on her face.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve meaning with natural Hindi phrasing. Replace the current translation phrase that uses an incorrect/odd word ("चेहरा भौंरा कर खड़ी हो गयी") with a clearer rendering that preserves the original tone: "एड्रियाना सख्त भंगिमा बनाकर खड़ी हो गई।" Ensure the surrounding HTML and tags remain unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: एड्रियाना चेहरा भौंरा कर खड़ी हो गयी। प्लेहाउस! वह इसके लिए बहुत बड़ी थी!
